subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the garden in Mondstadt

746760102.text: After everything, I've finally made it to the place where the story of those two legends began. Seeing how much I've given to be here...

746760103.text: Surely fate will smile upon me too! It won't be long now before I'll meet them once more!

746760104.text: What's that person rambling on about? Judging from how she's dressed, she doesn't seem to be from Mondstadt... D'you think she's from Inazuma?

746760105.text: Aha, you're here, and even sooner than expected! Time for a cheer to celebrate our reunion, "Twin Stars of Brilliant Valor"!

746760107.text: S—Souka, is that you!? Paimon never would have expected to see you here in Mondstadt. What a pleasant surprise!

746760111.text: But weren't you previously helping Haniyyah prepare for the next tournament? How come you're in Mondstadt all by yourself?

746760112.text: And all those books in front of you... You're not here to recommend novels to passers-by, are you?

746760113.text: Ah, well, I suppose the main reason is...

746760114.text: I'm being hunted down by Yae Publishing House's editors.

746760116.text: Don't worry, they're not literally going to kill me! They're just constantly pressing me to submit my work by whatever means necessary... I guess if you think about it, they're doing it for my own good!

746760117.text: As a once-popular light novelist, I had to keep producing new content non-stop, both to satisfy our readers' voracious appetites and to maintain my popularity.

746760118.text: But the speed at which our readers get through it all seems to know no limits! If I didn't keep up, it wouldn't be long before I found myself completely snowed under by new requests...

746760119.text: But I couldn't bring myself to rush through the story of my Fungi buddies just to get it finished. After all, it takes time to come up with a good idea and then gradually refine it.

746760120.text: If possible, I'd like to finish writing up the whole story, then go through the revision process before finally publishing it in its entirety. The last thing I want is to agree to serialize, and then have to rush to meet the deadlines for each issue.

746760121.text: So for now, I've decided to start working on a new main piece with a simpler, more manageable story instead. This way, at least the readers won't forget me!

746760109.text: You look so familiar... Is it really you, Souka?

746760110.text: #{NICKNAME}, you might have forgotten, but Souka's a writer we met during the Fungi tournament. She's been helping us and Haniyyah take care of our Fungi buddies...
